purpose: The parent area behind a password: reports, calendar, export, answers log, points, managing children, display settings, password and parent PIN.
details: Ouderdeel is opened from the 'Wie ben jij?' screen (kinderen.py). open() asks the parent password (or creates it on first use, upgrading an outdated hash), sets a 10-minute inactivity lock (Scherm.slot; Vergrendeld is caught and shown as a message), and shows the menu. Everything it reads or writes goes through storage (app.opslag) or kern modules (rapporten, stopslot, wachtwoord, reeks, feedback, foutlog); this file only asks and shows. The per-child settings list (kind_beheren) uses `lijst()`, a generic 'name: value' list screen. Passwords and PINs are stored hashed (kern/wachtwoord); the child PIN uses fewer iterations (PIN_ITERATIES) for speed. Dangerous actions (wipe a child) require typing the child's name.
module_docstring: Het ouderdeel (achter een wachtwoord): rapporten, kalender, export, kinderen beheren.

constants.name: SLOT_SECONDEN
constants.explanation: Inactivity time after which the parent area locks (10 minutes).

constants.name: PIN_ITERATIES
constants.explanation: Hash iterations for a child PIN (fewer than a password: a 4-digit PIN is guessable anyway).

constants.name: VERGETEN
constants.explanation: Help text for a forgotten password.

classes.name: Ouderdeel
classes.explanation: The parent area controller, created per visit by the child-selection screen.

methods.name: __init__
methods.explanation: Stores the app, its Scherm and storage.

methods.name: open
methods.docstring: Vraagt het wachtwoord en toont het ouderdeel. Komt terug als de ouder klaar is.
methods.explanation: Entry point: checks access, sets the inactivity lock and shows the menu; shows a message when the lock closes it; always clears the lock at the end; a breadcrumb click just returns.

methods.name: toegang
methods.explanation: Asks the parent password (three tries; first-time setup if none exists); rehashes an outdated stored hash on success; after three failures shows 'Geen toegang'. Returns True when access is granted.

methods.name: nieuw_wachtwoord
methods.explanation: Asks a new password (at least 4 characters) twice and stores its hash. Returns False on Esc.

methods.name: wachtwoord_wijzigen
methods.explanation: Asks the current password, then runs nieuw_wachtwoord, and confirms.

methods.name: wachtwoord_en_pin
methods.explanation: Menu for the password and the parent PIN: change password, choose/change the PIN, or remove it (which also switches off every child's stop lock and reloads the child).

methods.name: nieuwe_ouderpin
methods.docstring: De ouderpin kiezen (twee keer typen). True als ze bewaard is.
methods.explanation: Asks a 4-digit parent PIN twice and stores it through kern/stopslot. True when saved.

methods.name: melding
methods.explanation: Shows a titled message page with Enter to close; ✘ lines in the error role, ✔ in the good role.

methods.name: kies_kind
methods.explanation: Menu to choose a child (with school year and '· op slot'); a message and None when there are no children.

methods.name: lijst
methods.docstring: Een lijst 'naam: waarde' om te wijzigen. Geeft de gekozen index of None (Esc).
methods.explanation: Generic list screen of 'label  value' lines to change; ↑↓/jk/Tab/clicks/wheel move, Enter or Space picks, Esc leaves; the message wraps over three lines. Returns the chosen index or None.

methods.name: fouten_info
methods.explanation: Info line for the menu: the number of stored unexpected errors (with the hint to view them with --fouten), or nothing.

methods.name: menu
methods.explanation: The parent menu: Rapporten, Antwoorden, Kinderen, Punten, Wachtwoord en ouderpin, Opmerkingen (with count), Sluiten; dispatches to the methods below.

methods.name: opmerkingen
methods.explanation: Shows the remarks written through 'Zeg het ons', newest first, with the file they are stored in.

methods.name: rapporten
methods.explanation: Loop: choose a child, then a period, and show the report.

methods.name: kies_periode
methods.explanation: Menu of the standard periods plus 'Zelf kiezen' (two typed dates, swapped if reversed). Returns a Periode or None.

methods.name: vraag_datum
methods.explanation: Asks a date (dd/mm/yyyy) until it parses; an empty answer gives the default when allowed; Esc gives None.

methods.name: toon_rapport
methods.explanation: Builds the report with kern/rapporten and shows it in a reader with E (export) and K (calendar) actions until Esc.

methods.name: exporteer
methods.explanation: Exports the report as text and CSV into the documents folder and shows the paths, or the error.

methods.name: kalender
methods.explanation: Month calendar with coloured practice days and a list of the first eight days with counts and percentage; ←/→ change month, Esc leaves.

methods.name: antwoorden
methods.explanation: Loop: choose a child and show their answers.

methods.name: antwoorden_van
methods.docstring: De laatste antwoorden (nieuwste eerst): ↑↓ kiezen, Enter = details, H = in de herhaalbak.
methods.explanation: The latest answers newest first with scrolling (arrows, PgUp/PgDn, wheel, click): Enter shows details, H puts the question in the repeat bin, Esc leaves.

methods.name: herhaal
methods.docstring: H: de vraag in de herhaalbak. Geeft de melding.
methods.explanation: Puts an answered question's skill and key in the repeat bin and returns the message (already in, success, or not possible).

methods.name: antwoord_details
methods.explanation: Detail page for one answer: skill, level, mode, question, answer, verdict, thinking error, time and tip use, klad lines, repeat-bin state; H adds to the repeat bin.

methods.name: punten
methods.explanation: Loop: choose a child, show their points balance and last 30 changes, and offer B to give bonus points with a reason (stored as 'bonus van de ouders').

methods.name: kinderen
methods.explanation: Loop: choose a child and manage them.

methods.name: kind_beheren
methods.explanation: The settings list of one child: name (unique), school year, display settings, timer visibility, PIN, stop lock, mixed-practice mode, shop penalty, export everything, wipe everything. Each choice stores its change right away and reloads the active child.

methods.name: gemengd_oefenen
methods.docstring: Wie kiest de thema's van Gemengd oefenen: het kind, vast (de ouder), of één keer (de volgende reeks).
methods.explanation: Chooses who picks the themes of Gemengd oefenen (child, fixed, or once) and, for parent modes, which themes; stores it in the child's settings and returns a message.

methods.name: weergave
methods.docstring: Hoe het programma eruitziet voor dit kind (vroeger Opties bij het kind). Elke keuze wordt meteen bewaard en geldt meteen als dit kind het actieve is; een startargument (--ascii …) gaat voor zolang het programma loopt.
methods.explanation: The display settings of a child (simple characters, mouse, typing direction in tables, avatar, animations, clock in a separate window, place values); each toggle is stored and applied at once.

methods.name: pincode
methods.explanation: Sets or removes a child's PIN (four digits typed twice, stored hashed) and returns the message.

methods.name: stoppen_op_slot
methods.docstring: Aan of uit. Aanzetten zonder ouderpin vraagt eerst een ouderpin (zonder pin geldt geen slot).
methods.explanation: Turns the stop lock of a child on or off; switching on needs a parent PIN (asked first if none exists).

methods.name: exporteer_alles
methods.explanation: Exports all data of a child (CSV report over all time plus a JSON file with everything) and shows the paths, or returns the error.

methods.name: wissen
methods.explanation: Wipes a child completely after the parent types the child's name; returns True when wiped.

functions.name: gemengd_waarde
functions.docstring: Wat er bij Kinderen › kind › Gemengd oefenen staat: wie de thema's kiest.
functions.explanation: Text for the 'Gemengd oefenen' line in the child list: 'het kind kiest', or the parent's mode with theme names (or a count when more than two).
